content: {"episode_id":"ep-05084","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93271 was ordered to evaluate recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that raise concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) in a patient with a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9). The cardiac event monitoring study was indicated to identify arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events and to guide anticoagulation management, as documented in the clinical indication note. We request reconsideration of the CO-97 denial on the basis of this documented clinical indication."}
